说明: 本文件在地面端每次主动启动机载程序时读取。{uav_id} 自动替换为所选无人机编号，{model} 替换为 p600 或 su17。指令在机载 ~/competition_development 中由 Bash 执行。修改后先停止对应程序，再点击重新连接并启动；不会自动重启已有程序。

commands.detection:
source ~/SpireCV_bj/src/spirecv-ros/devel/setup.bash
exec roslaunch spirecv_ros uav_yolo26_botsort_geolocation.launch uav_id:={uav_id} runtime_mode:=debug debug_save_dir:=/tmp/yolo_debug
commands.flight: source ~/recon_ws/devel/setup.bash && exec roslaunch px4_north_camera p600_gx40_position_pid_reconnaissance.launch uav_id:={uav_id} flight_mode:=outdoor_small_range
